ml_match.prompt_snippet:
Opus 5.5 on the Trading House

❯ Using React/TypeScript (Remotion), every image drawn in SVG and Canvas, an open-source TTS voice, and a score synthesized in Python. No stock footage. No image generators.

❯ Build a short 30-60s animation work about the Trading House

scenes.voiceover: See the markets in action. Experience the clarity of the Kite platform.

scenes.voiceover: Navigate real-time charts and execute trades with the intuitive Kite interface.

scenes.voiceover: Designed for transparency, Kite provides the tools you need to track your portfolio.
scenes.veo_prompt: Abstract digital visualization of a growing equity graph with a clean, modern aesthetic.

scenes.voiceover: See it in action for yourself. Get started on Zerodha today.
